title: Control Flow and Error Handling
description: Write procedural T-SQL with BEGIN/END, IF/ELSE, and WHILE loops. Gracefully handle errors with TRY/CATCH, RAISERROR, and THROW. Build flexible queries with dynamic SQL.
whatYouLearn: How to use BEGIN/END blocks, IF/ELSE conditions, and WHILE loops to control execution flow
How to use BREAK and CONTINUE to control loop execution
How to handle errors gracefully with TRY/CATCH and diagnose them using ERROR_* functions
How to raise custom errors with RAISERROR and THROW
How to build dynamic SQL queries at runtime using sp_executesql and prevent SQL injection
